summary: Then create secret rhdh-postgresql-secrets with POSTGRES_USER, PASSWORD, HOST, PORT and DB, set upstream.postgresql.enabled: false and backstage.appConfig.backend.database (client pg, connection from those env vars, ssl.rejectUnauthorized) with extraEnvVarsSecrets, run helm upgrade, and watch pods with oc get pods -w.
questions: How do I configure the portal Helm chart for an external database?
How do I disable embedded PostgreSQL in the portal?
What secret holds the portal database credentials?
rejectUnauthorized false in portal database config

answer_card.title: Point the portal at an external PostgreSQL
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc create secret generic rhdh-postgresql-secrets \
  --from-literal=POSTGRES_USER=rhdh_user \
  --from-literal=POSTGRES_PASSWORD=<password> \
  --from-literal=POSTGRES_HOST=<database-host> \
  --from-literal=POSTGRES_PORT=5432 \
  --from-literal=POSTGRES_DB=rhdh_production -n <namespace>
```
```yaml
upstream:
  postgresql:
    enabled: false
  backstage:
    appConfig:
      backend:
        database:
          client: pg
          connection:
            host: ${POSTGRES_HOST}
            port: ${POSTGRES_PORT}
            user: ${POSTGRES_USER}
            password: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
            database: ${POSTGRES_DB}
            ssl:
              rejectUnauthorized: false  # true with verified certs
    extraEnvVarsSecrets:
      - rhdh-postgresql-secrets
```
`helm upgrade <release> <chart> -f values.yaml -n <namespace>`, then `oc get pods -n <namespace> -w`.
